text:
alex.jones (Acme): Hey team — our prod app started getting 403s from /v1/generate around 09:12 UTC. Customer says same API key was working earlier today. Can someone help?

maya.s (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, Alex. Can you paste the full curl (with api key redacted) and the response body you saw? Also send org id and request_id if available.

alex.jones (Acme): Sure — org: org_8601, request_id: r_20260315_091217_3f2e. Curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED\" -d '{"model":"pro-advanced","input":"hi"}'`

Response: `{"error":{"message":"Access denied","code":403}}` — no extra fields.

maya.s (Support): Ok thanks. That `code: 403` without an entitlement code can look auth-y. I'm pulling logs. @entitlement-bot can you show entitlement check result for org_8601 around that request_id?

entitlement-bot: entitlement_check log: `ts=2026-03-15T09:12:17Z org=org_8601 req=r_20260315_091217_3f2e status=DENIED reason=feature_flag required=pro feature=advanced_generation`

maya.s (Support): Looks like the entitlement system denied the request: feature gate `advanced_generation` requires a Pro plan. This is an entitlement 403, not an auth key failure.

alex.jones (Acme): Wait — our customer is on a paid plan tho, they upgraded in Jan. Billing?

kevin.t (Billing): Checking org_8601 subscriptions... I see a billing failure and the subscription fell back to Free on 2026-03-14 22:47 UTC due to a failed card charge. There was a retry but it looks like it didn't succeed.

alex.jones (Acme): ugh. They didn't get any billing emails? They have multiple seats.

kevin.t (Billing): Email bounced earlier — contact email for billing is bouncing. I'm starting a payment retry and PMing the customer. I can also temporarily re-enable entitlements for their org after verification.

samir (Eng): Re: the 403 — the runtime currently returns generic 403 JSON for both auth failures and entitlement failures in older codepaths. We recently rolled a change to surface `entitlement_code` but it wasn't enabled for the `generate` endpoint in prod rollout. So support sees a plain 403.

olga (PM): This pattern causes repeated escalations where customers think the API key is invalid. We should patch the error body to include `entitlement_error` and a human-friendly message. Also doc update.

maya.s (Support): For Alex: short-term workaround: use model `base` or any model included on Free plan; that should avoid the entitlement gate. Or Kevin can temporarily grant `advanced_generation` flag to org_8601 while billing is sorted. Which do you prefer?

alex.jones (Acme): We'll ask the customer if they want the temporary gate. Ideally we want to keep rollover minimal; can you give exact repro steps I can send them and a copy/paste message?

maya.s (Support): Yep — send them this: 
```
# Try the lighter model to confirm entitlement vs auth
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"base\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
If that returns 200, it's an entitlement gating issue. If still 403, reply with the request_id and we'll escalate auth.

samir (Eng): Adding repro for internal debug: use the original request and enable debug headers to trace entitlement flow: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"X-Debug-Trace: entitlement\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"pro-advanced\",\"input\":\"test\"}'
```
Look for logs: `entitlement_check: DENIED plan=free required=pro feature=advanced_generation` and `response_code: 403 entitlement_code: PLAN_ENTITLEMENT`.

kevin.t (Billing): I granted a temporary entitlement to org_8601 and retried a one-time invoice charge with the customer's updated card. Will report back once payment confirms.

entitlement-bot: update: `org=org_8601 flag=advanced_generation status=GRANTED temp_until=2026-03-16T09:12:00Z actor=kevin.t`

alex.jones (Acme): Confirmed customer can generate now — 200 OK. Thanks. Can we get a clearer error message so other customers don't waste time?

olga (PM): Filing a small PR: change 403 response bodies to include `{"error":{"message":...,"type":"entitlement","entitlement_code":"PLAN_ENTITLEMENT"}}` when entitlement service denies. Also adding a short support doc and SDK error mapping.

samir (Eng): I'll pick up the change and make it a hotfix on the error handler path. Also will add a quick telemetry metric to count `entitlement_vs_auth_confusion` to track regressions.

maya.s (Support): Ticket updated: TKT-4521. Summary: 403 returned for pro model due to subscription downgrade, entitlement response masked as auth failure. Root cause: billing card failed -> plan fallback -> entitlement DENIED. Actions: temp grant applied, payment retried, hotfix PR for clearer 403 body, support doc.

alex.jones (Acme): Great — customer notified and unblocked. Please keep me posted if payment fails again.

kevin.t (Billing): Will follow up with the customer separately to confirm card and set up billing alerts.

samir (Eng): Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1629 (WIP). Plan to ship within 3 hours.

olga (PM): Also adding a note for the rollout checklist: entitlement error visibility must be enabled for all user-facing endpoints before feature flag launches.

maya.s (Support): Closing loop with customer and will leave ticket open until billing confirmed. :white_check_mark:
